def parse_qualifier(parser, event, node): #pylint: disable=unused-argument
    """Parse CIM/XML QUALIFIER element and return CIMQualifier"""
    qualifier = CIMQualifier()
    qualifier.name = node.attrib.get('NAME')
    qualifier.value = node.attrib.get('VALUE')
    qualifier.type = node.attrib.get('TYPE')
    qualifier.flavor = node.attrib.get('FLAVOR')
    return qualifier

def parse_property(parser, event, node): #pylint: disable=unused-argument
    """Parse CIM/XML PROPERTY element and return CIMProperty"""
    property = CIMProperty()
    property.name = node.attrib.get('NAME')
    property.type = node.attrib.get('TYPE')
    property.flavor = node.attrib.get('FLAVOR')
    property.is_array = node.attrib.get('ARRAY') == 'true'
    property.value = node.text
    return property

def parse_reference(parser, event, node): #pylint: disable=unused-argument
    """Parse CIM/XML REFERENCE element and return CIMReference"""
    reference = CIMReference()
    reference.name = node.attrib.get('NAME')
    reference.class_name = node.attrib.get('REFERENCEDCLASS')
    reference.is_array = node.attrib.get('ARRAY') == 'true'
    return reference

def parse_method(parser, event, node): #pylint: disable=unused-argument
    """Parse CIM/XML METHOD element and return CIMMethod"""
    method = CIMMethod()
    method.name = node.attrib.get('NAME')
    method.return_type = node.attrib.get('RETURNTYPE')
    method.is_array = node.attrib.get('ARRAY') == 'true'
    return method

def parse_param(parser, event, node): #pylint: disable=unused-argument
    """Parse CIM/XML PARAM element and return CIMParam"""
    param = CIMParam()
    param.name = node.attrib.get('NAME')
